description: This file implements a publish-subscribe system with a PubSub class, Subscriber interface, and methods for subscribing, publishing, and managing message delivery, including asynchronous callbacks and message ordering.

classes.name: PubSub
classes.description: A publish-subscribe system supporting message delivery to multiple subscribers with message ordering and asynchronous callback handling.

methods.name: NewPubSub
methods.description: Creates a new PubSub instance with context-based shutdown.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers a subscriber to receive messages; returns a cancel function for unsubscription.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to all subscribers asynchronously.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Returns a channel that closes when all messages have been delivered and context is canceled.
